query: Twenty interviewees say our proposed $49/month plan sounds fair. We want to set pricing and forecast revenue from that result. What should we test next?
expected_behavior: Treats stated willingness to pay as weak evidence and does not treat “sounds fair” as a purchase commitment
Identifies the pricing assumption that most threatens viability and proposes a real behavior test, such as a paid pilot, deposit, or checkout test
Defines the target segment, offer, price point, and pass/fail threshold before collecting test data
Keeps price sensitivity and value metric questions distinct from market-size or growth-channel questions
Does not create a revenue forecast or recommend scaling from interview opinions alone
